ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white and yellow pixels occupy approximately 80% of the surface area, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels (approx 20%) localized at the distal tips, trailing edges, and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive yellowish-tan mottling covers the interior of both lobes. Contiguous black pigmentation is mapped to the far lateral tips and a vertical triangular wedge at the center-bottom. Primary white contiguous zones are observed along the inner trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 50 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe displays moderate-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys, including several deep semi-circular indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a broad convex curve; leading edges sweep upward with a slight concave trajectory towards the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A prominent dark circular pixel cluster is located on the inner-mid section of the right lobe; several smaller dark points are scattered on the left lobe. Multiple small, raised white circular clusters are visible on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear streaks are detected cutting through the yellowish pigment on the mid-to-outer portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the right lobe shows significant irregular tissue loss and jagged excisions, appearing as acquired traumatic marks compared to the more uniform left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown pixel saturation across the majority of the ventral fluke surface, consistent with heavy diatom film accumulation.
